footnote: Source: State Council Guofa [2018] No. 41, [2022] No. 8 and [2023] No. 13 (in force from January 1, 2023)
notes: There are seven special additional deductions, and in 2023 the State Council raised three of them, not all seven. Infant care for children under 3 and children's education each went from RMB 1,000 to 2,000 per child a month. Support for elderly parents went from 2,000 to 3,000 a month, and siblings who share it can take at most 1,500 each. The other four did not change. Further education: RMB 400 a month for a degree course, or 3,600 in the year you obtain a vocational or professional certificate. Serious illness: the part of your own out-of-pocket costs under the medical insurance list above RMB 15,000, up to 80,000, and only at year end. Mortgage interest on a first home: 1,000 a month. Rent: 1,500, 1,100 or 800 a month depending on the city. Watch out: one child means 2,000 a month in total, taken by one parent or split in half. Mortgage interest and rent cannot both be claimed in the same year, and a couple working in the same city can only claim rent once.
